pipeline: PROBE → EXTRACT → VALIDATE → CLASSIFY → PREPARE RECONSTRUCTION

input.video_codec_long: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

analysis.interpretation: Frame decoding failures are directly observed. Pixel-level visual damage is not automatically inferred from ordinary frame differences.

reconstruction.warning: AI-generated video frames are inferred content and must not be treated as verified original evidence.

forensic_principle: Only directly observed decoding failures are marked as damaged. AI-generated visual content remains AI-INFERRED and is never represented as verified original data.
